interpretation_rules: An interval that includes zero does not establish a difference.
Three seeds on one shared synthetic test split are not independent datasets; no significance claim.
Validation and test PR-AUC are not compared directly because prevalence differs (0.0895% vs 0.5198%).
analysis.primary_comparison: per-seed difference Transformer minus Phase 16 history-enabled SGD; mean, sample SD (ddof=1) and descriptive two-sided 95% Student-t interval with df=2
secondary: Transformer test and validation mean and sample SD across seeds for average_precision, pr_auc, roc_auc, precision, recall, f1 at the frozen thresholds
average precision lift over split prevalence
training time, scoring time, epoch losses

comparator.description: Phase 16 history-enabled SGD arm (current token plus 17 history buckets), test metrics per seed, read from its frozen replay manifest.
comparator.pairing: by seed label only; the two model families do not share initialisation or batch order

dataset.target: current transaction isFraud; target and historical labels are not input features

model.configuration: layernet_ml.paysim_temporal.TRANSFORMER_CONFIG (unchanged; must equal the Phase 12 configuration at run time)
model.positive_class_weight_rule: train negatives / train positives (train recipient targets only)

protocol: Verify archive, contract, configuration and preregistration hashes; refuse to write into an existing output directory.
Train each seed on train targets only and save its artifact before any scoring.
Reload saved artifacts; score validation; select each seed's threshold by maximum validation F1 (ties: higher precision, then higher threshold).
Write selection-freeze.json with artifact hashes and thresholds before the test partition is opened.
Score the test partition once per seed with the frozen threshold (inclusive rule score >= threshold).
No retraining, threshold change or model selection after the test partition is opened.
purpose: Estimate seed variability of the existing Phase 12 temporal Transformer configuration and compare it, paired by seed label, with the Phase 16 history-enabled SGD arm on the same fixed PaySim split.

reproduction_check.description: Seed 42 uses the Phase 12 seed and configuration. Its validation metrics are compared with the Phase 12 values recorded in ml/reports/paysim-temporal-reproduction-v1.md (the Phase 12 manifest itself is currently unreadable).
reproduction_check.on_mismatch: record as a deviation; the run continues and seed 42 is still analysed as a fresh seed
reproduction_check.tolerance: absolute 1e-9 for the 12-significant-digit report values; counts exact
